training.curriculum: Initial positions, velocities, headings and target motion expand linearly to the full randomized distribution during the first 20% of training.

evaluation.targetPattern: 50% static; 50% smooth sinusoids, randomized center, amplitude, phase and frequency
evaluation.successDefinition: Final 60 steps: mean distance < 0.45 m and mean speed < 0.8 m/s
evaluation.escapeHandling: Escape is terminal; remaining steps receive sqrt(50) m error and -0.1*sqrt(50) reward, zero thrust/spin. Failed episodes cannot count as successes.
